research_question: Does frozen Full Evidence V2 predict the 63-session forward stock return in the broad Evidence-eligible universe after point-in-time factor controls?

independence_classification.reason: A secondary forward-return result was already observed in the 1,640-row Future ERI panel before this protocol was frozen.
independence_classification.true_oos_policy: Only signals first available strictly after the OOS start can support a new alpha claim.

frozen_inputs.security_type_policy: Retain the exact sealed 37,014-row Full/Core intersection; COMMON in the universe label refers to the common Full/Core evidence intersection, not to common-stock security type.

primary_outcome.name: forward_return_63_open_to_close
primary_outcome.definition: Signal-session Close/Open minus one, compounded with MARCAP ChangesRatio for the following 62 common sessions through the target session.
primary_outcome.reason_for_open_anchor: The filing signal is timestamped at the market open; the prior-close-to-open gap is excluded.

factor_controls.size: log exact signal-session Open market capitalization

value_parallel_metrics.value_btm: positive PIT book equity / signal market capitalization
value_parallel_metrics.value_sales_yield: positive PIT annual sales / signal market capitalization
value_parallel_metrics.value_operating_income_yield: positive PIT operating income / signal market capitalization
value_parallel_metrics.value_ebit_ev_yield: positive PIT operating income / positive enterprise value
value_parallel_metrics.value_assets_yield: positive PIT total assets / signal market capitalization

factor_controls.value_core_composite: Within-month mean rank-normal score across at least three available parallel Value metrics.
factor_controls.growth: latest valid PIT annual revenue / prior valid PIT annual revenue minus one
factor_controls.quality: latest PIT annual (operating income minus debt) / total assets; CFO-free broad definition

statistics.primary: equal-weight mean of monthly Spearman IC between frozen Full Evidence and primary forward return
secondary: Strong Bull minus Strong Bear median forward return
five-band count, mean, median, and positive-return share
direct close/open and next-open anchored return sensitivities

pre_return_amendment.reason: Clarify that the pre-existing phrase common Full/Core intersection names the intersection of two Evidence panels and is not a common-stock filter.
